teachingQuestion: How does an incident move from signal to safer operations and improvement?
focalInsight: Response is a controlled loop of triage, containment, eradication, recovery, communication, and learning.
title: Incident-management loop
caption: Every phase preserves evidence and informs the next control improvement.
altSummary: An incident loop moves through triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and learning, returning improvements to future readiness and detection.
textFallback: Validate and scope the signal, contain harm while preserving evidence, eradicate persistence, recover a trustworthy service, communicate accurately, and assign lessons with owners and validation. Feed improvements back into plans and controls.
